description: Seven open-web queries do not reproduce LexisNexis or systematically screen every week, region and sector; no zero-event conclusion is supported.
Dec 3 action confirmed, but report lists vehicles rather than simultaneous people. Government position on Mercosur leaves exact demand/state target for review.
TVN confirms blockade and domestic policy demand, but gives no attendee count.
TVN reports activists waited but met only journalists; no count/public-crowd size. ESKA is prospective only.

TVN quotes a participant saying about 50; Raport Warszawski reports >40 from movement account. Count is not independent. Sources differ over police intervention and one page has a weekday/date inconsistency.
Dec 4, 11 and 13 remain separate site/date records. Wider onset, intervening actions and post-Dec continuity are not established.
